name: TWISTER MILL
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-TWM-100X Twister Mill (Cyclone Mill) is highly utilized in the food, feed, and pharmaceutical industries. It is specifically used for ultra-fast, uniform grinding of dry, brittle samples like grains, seeds, and tobacco prior to NIR analysis. The integrated cyclone mechanism automatically separates the ground sample, drastically increasing throughput.
features: Maximum 16000 rpm speed setting with rotor peripheral speed of 82 m/s
Cyclone separator collects samples quickly and reduces cleaning time
High speed powerful motor ensures high grinding efficiency
Soft touch control panel design for easy operation
Supplied with 0.3mm & 0.8mm sieves and 250ml sample bottles

specifications.Target Applications: Grains, Seeds, Feed, and Tobacco Grinding for NIR Analysis
